# StackedPanel { #anylumino.StackedPanel }

```python
StackedPanel(
    widgets=None,
    *,
    titles=None,
    keys=None,
    selected_index=0,
    width='100%',
    height=420,
    resizable=True,
    fit_content=False,
)
```

Lumino stacked panel that shows one selected child at a time.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                     | Description                                      | Default   |
|----------------|--------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| widgets        | iterable or mapping      | Child widgets or keyed child mapping.            | `None`    |
| titles         | iterable or mapping      | Optional labels associated with children.        | `None`    |
| keys           | iterable of str          | Stable child keys for iterable ``widgets``.      | `None`    |
| selected_index | int                      | Initially visible child index.                   | `0`       |
| width          | int, float, str, or None | Widget width.                                    | `'100%'`  |
| height         | int, float, str, or None | Widget height.                                   | `420`     |
| resizable      | bool                     | Whether the panel gets a notebook resize handle. | `True`    |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [layout_kind](#anylumino.StackedPanel.layout_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
| [selected_index](#anylumino.StackedPanel.selected_index) | An int trait. |
